methodology.timings: Fresh sequential worker processes; alternate before/after order across cases; 2 warmups then 7 timed sample operations with GC before each. Full streaming: 2 passes per variant. Counts and writer byte SHA256 compared.
methodology.allocations: Separate V8 HeapProfiler sampling runs at 65536 bytes, including objects collected by minor and major GC. Estimates include profiling overhead and are not exact allocation counts or peak heap. 10 operations per case; 3 for 4000-triple RDF writes.
methodology.gc: PerformanceObserver GC entries whose start time falls within the instrumented operation loop; startup/forced pre-loop GC excluded. Durations are observed GC events, not equivalent to CPU profiler percentages.
methodology.retention: Keep parser and all encoded frame buffers reachable; discard outputs; compare post-forced-GC heap after 1000 and 50000 message/result scopes. Small negative deltas are GC noise, not a memory reduction guarantee.
methodology.sample: Same 870 complete messages / 100050 triples as the original audit. SPARQL uses s/p/o SELECT bindings synthesized from these triples.
methodology.limitations: One regular dataset; sample timing noise; only two full repetitions; no browser throughput benchmark. Prefix compression/lookup reuse are unchanged.

validation.check: 565 tests, TypeScript and Node/browser build passed
validation.writerByteEquality: SHA256 unchanged before/after for every measured RDF/SPARQL writer case
